g.title: macros
g.text: oams_macros.cfg, one toolchange (T<n>) from top to bottom; a failure pauses the print, and RESUME re-enters where it stopped

g.title: t_n
g.text: the slicer: print start and each colour change

g.title: catch
g.text: runs the chain below and catches any failure in it

g.title: catch_u
g.text: the same catch point, for the unload

g.title: plan_u
g.text: Panel Unload only: its own plan, homes if needed

g.title: plan
g.text: works out the temperature, shows the plan on the displays

g.title: home
g.text: only if the printer isn't homed

g.title: hb_tx
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (run by _OAMS_HEAT)

g.title: hb_u
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (run by _OAMS_HEAT)

g.title: heat_tx
g.text: heats and waits, only if the nozzle is colder

g.title: feed
g.text: the AMS feeds the group's next spool to the extruder gears,

g.title: heat_u
g.text: heats and waits, only if the nozzle is colder

g.title: follow
g.text: the AMS follows the extruder backwards

g.title: ret1
g.text: a short retract before the cut

g.title: cut
g.text: the cutter moves: pre_cut → cut → post_cut

g.title: ocut
g.text: CUT_FILAMENT runs it instead of the moves

g.title: ret2
g.text: pulls the cut end out of the extruder gears

g.title: ret3
g.text: an extra retract before the rewind

g.title: rewind
g.text: the AMS rewinds the filament to its bay

g.title: h_ret
g.text: yours, if you wrote one (a swap only)

g.title: reload
g.text: the extruder pushes it from the gears into the melt zone:

g.title: restore
g.text: heater back (idle printer only), toolhead back to the print

g.title: fault
g.text: any failure: a red check, homing, heating, the cutter, the AMS refusing,
a hook, CLEAN_NOZZLE, the Stop button. It records the step, the
reason and the group on the lane, puts the toolhead back where the
toolchange started (unless it had to home first) and stops the
follower once it is safe. The heater stays on.

g.title: pause
g.text: the print pauses and the reason is in the console:
the toolchange to T1 failed at the <step> step: <reason>
and the idle timeout goes to
so the heaters and motors stay on and the printer keeps its position

g.title: perr
g.text: no print: Retry, Unload or Reset

g.title: resume
g.text: once you have fixed the cause

g.title: reset
g.text: clears the AMS's faults, re-reads the lanes

g.title: lost
g.text: the motors went off while it waited; nothing moves,
the print stays paused: cancel it

g.title: r_fin
g.text: the follower on, then goes on from D: no second reload

g.title: r_tool
g.text: follower on, then goes on from B

g.title: r_tx
g.text: the feed when nothing is loaded, the whole swap
when another group is, a rewind of that bay first
when its feed stopped short; all of it when the

g.title: again
g.text: Re-entered, the chain runs on as drawn:
, or a check fails again and
the print pauses again. Before Klipper's resume
takes the toolhead back to the pause position,
RESUME checks that the toolhead holds the
print's group; if not it refuses (
An Unload or Load during the pause keeps the
failed toolchange; a later T<n> of the same
macro moves nothing and becomes the target.
OpenAMS never retries on its own.

g.title: b_feed
g.text: the AMS feeds to the extruder gears

g.title: b_tl
g.text: heats if the spool's temperature is known

g.title: b_rel
g.text: the same move as a toolchange

g.title: runout
g.text: no macro runs: OpenAMS feeds a spare bay of the same group,
or runs PAUSE when it has none

g.title: b_fol
g.text: the AMS follows the extruder backwards

g.title: b_ej
g.text: heats if colder, 10 mm forward to soften
the tip, 100 mm back in 25 mm moves

g.title: b_rew
g.text: the AMS rewinds it to its bay
